fields.label: Frappe User
fields.description: Select the login account. Display name and effective roles are fetched from this User.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.description: Read only; fetched from Frappe User.full_name.

fields.label: Assigned User Roles
fields.description: Read only; fetched from the linked Frappe User and refreshed when you select an account. A POS permission can restrict an action but cannot grant access without the required Frappe role.

fields.label: Add Items to Other Cashiers’ Open Orders
fields.description: Allows adding items and confirming them for preparation. The cashier who opened the order remains responsible for payment, cancellation and session accounting.

fields.label: Maximum Manual Discount (%)
fields.description: Maximum discount this POS User can apply without approval. Larger discounts require authorization from a POS Manager.

fields.label: Record Expenses Without Approval
fields.description: If disabled, POS expenses require an operation-specific manager approval code.

fields.label: Fixed Discount Approval Password
fields.description: Optional separate password managers can enter to approve discounts. It is encrypted and never used as the Frappe login password.

fields.label: Allowed Brands
fields.description: Leave empty to allow all Brands available in the assigned Stores.

fields.label: Allowed Order Types
fields.description: Leave empty to allow all Order Types available in the assigned Stores.

fields.label: Allowed Preparation Areas
fields.description: Leave empty to allow all Preparation Areas in the assigned Stores.

fields.label: View Kitchen Display
fields.description: Also requires a POS Cashier, POS Manager, System Manager, or Kitchen Operator role.

fields.label: Start and Prepare Kitchen Orders
fields.description: Restricts kitchen preparation actions. Starting or preparing tickets also requires the Kitchen Operator, POS Manager, or System Manager role.

fields.label: Mark Orders Picked Up
fields.description: Restricts pickup actions. Marking tickets picked up also requires the Kitchen Operator, POS Manager, or System Manager role.

fields.label: Acknowledge Kitchen Cancellations
fields.description: Restricts cancellation acknowledgement. Acknowledging tickets also requires the Kitchen Operator, POS Manager, or System Manager role.
